{{redirect|Goh's Pinsir|the Pinsir that Goh [[trade]]d away|Goh#Pinsir|Goh → Pinsir}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Bug |trainername=Goh |pokemonname=Pinsir |jtrainername=ゴウ |jpokemonname=カイロス |tmtrainername=Go |tmpokemonname=Kailios |image=[[File:Goh Pinsir.png|250px]] |caption=Goh's Pinsir |prevonum=127 |epnum=JN006 |epname=Working My Way Back to Mew! |location=[[Vermilion Forest]] |current=[[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]] |gender=Unknown |ability=Unknown |noevo=incap |java1=[[Shin-ichiro Miki]] |enva1= }} '''Goh's Pinsir''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのカイロス''' ''Go's Kailios'') is the seventh {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], and his eighth overall. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== [[File:Goh Heracross and Pinsir.png|left|thumb|250px|Pinsir and Heracross]] In ''[[JN006|Working My Way Back to Mew!]]'', [[Goh]] encountered Pinsir in [[Vermilion Forest]] while he was preparing to catch himself a {{p|Butterfree}}. Pinsir startled {{Ash}} and {{AP|Pikachu}} and began to attack. Scared, Goh started throwing things at Pinsir, eventually throwing a {{i|Poké Ball}} at it, causing it to be caught by Goh. It was later seen with Goh's other {{type|Bug}} Pokémon when [[Professor Cerise]] offered it a place in the [[Cerise Laboratory]]. In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', Pinsir tries to calm down some of Goh's other Pokémon while they started to argue. When {{TP|Goh|Golurk}} loses control, Pinsir joins the other Pokémon to help Goh's three {{p|Cascoon}} [[Evolution|evolve]] safely. In ''[[JN033|Trade, Borrow, and Steal!]]'', Goh met a girl named [[Kricketina Kylie]], who wanted to [[trade]] Pinsir for one of her Pokémon, something that Goh was reluctant to do. Goh offered to help Kricketina find a Pinsir of her own which they agreed to do. When Goh later caught another Pinsir, he traded it for Kricketina's {{TP|Goh|Heracross}} as his Pinsir had fallen in love with it. In ''[[JN094|Suffering the Flings and Arrows!]]'', Goh's newly caught {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Lilligant}} released a sweet aroma that caused Heracross to fall in love with her, leading Pinsir to grow depressed. Wanting to help Pinsir, Ash and Goh took it to the [[Celadon Gym]], where [[Erika]] was hosting [[Pokémon Flower Arrangement]]. Goh decorated Pinsir with a flowery dress so that it could impress Heracross, but just when he called out Heracross, {{TRT}} attacked the [[Gym]]. During the battle against them, Pinsir shielded Heracross from a {{m|Solar Beam}} before sending the villainous trio blasting off, earning back Heracross's love and admiration. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Pinsir attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. {{-}} ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Goh and Pinsir.png|thumb|250px|Pinsir and Goh]] Pinsir is a timid {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} who doesn't like to fight, as seen in ''[[JN007|Serving Up the Flute Cup!]]'' when Goh was considering which of his team to use in the [[Battle Frontier Flute Cup]], Pinsir avoided being chosen. This was seen again in ''[[JN033|Trade, Borrow, and Steal!]]'' when Goh was left to battle {{TRT}}, Pinsir hid behind a tree, not wishing to battle. It has often been seen with Goh's smaller {{type|Bug}} Pokémon, such as {{TP|Goh|Caterpie}}. When it is startled or uncomfortable it will often cower behind Goh or an object like a tree. Goh is generally accommodating to Pinsir's personality, and while he sometimes asks Pinsir if it is up for a battle, he never pressures it into battling against its will. Pinsir doesn't seem to like conflict as it was seen trying to prevent [[Goh's Grimer]] for getting aggressive over the food shortage in ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', as well as attempting to help the other Pokémon that Grimer was blaming. It loves picking flowers and can be playful with others of the lab. In ''[[JN033|Trade, Borrow, and Steal!]]'', Pinsir developed a crush on Heracross, which motivated Goh to [[trade]] his second Pinsir for Heracross so that they may be together. Pinsir's love for Heracross is so strong that it became depressed when it saw Heracross falling in love with Goh's newly caught {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Lilligant}}. This continued in ''[[JN107|Big Brother to the Rescue!]]'', and when {{TP|Professor Cerise|Yamper}} and {{TP|Goh|Panpour}} appeared to have sorted out the conflict, Heracross became attracted by {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Alcremie}}'s smell, leading Pinsir to become furious and attack Heracross. {{-}} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|bug||Goh Pinsir {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Rock Tomb|1=X-Scissor}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Rock Tomb|1=X-Scissor}}}} {{anmov|rock|Rock Tomb|JN006|Working My Way Back to Mew!}} {{anmov|bug|X-Scissor|JN094|Suffering the Flings and Arrows!}} {{anmov/f|bug}} ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{bug color dark}}; background: #{{bug color}}; font-size:80%;" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{bug color dark}}; background: #{{bug color light}}"| [[File:JN006 illustration.png|x250px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{bug color dark}}; background: #{{bug color light}}" | [[File:JN094 AS.png|x200px]] |- | Official artwork of
''{{color2|000|JN006|Working My Way Back to Mew!}}'' | Artwork from "After the story" https://twitter.com/anipoke_PR/status/1485130173280251904 |} ==In the games== ===[[Pokémon GO]]=== On November 6, 2020, as part of Pokémon GO's [https://pokemongo.nianticlabs.com/post/animationweek2020/?hl=en Animation Week 2020] event, which was based on {{aniseries|JN}}, several Pokémon based on those that Ash and Goh encountered in the ''Journeys'' series appeared more frequently in the wild, in {{GO|Raid Battle|raid}}s, from 7 km [[List of Eggs in Pokémon GO|Eggs]], and during [[Photography#Pokémon GO|surprise encounters]], with Pinsir appearing only in level 3 raids. The event ran from November 6, 2020, at 8:00 a.m., to November 12, 2020, at 10:00 p.m. local time. ==In the manga== [[File:Goh Bug Pokémon JNM.png|220px|thumb|right|Pinsir (along with Goh's other Bug Pokémon) in {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}}.]] ===Pokémon Journeys=== Pinsir debuted in ''[[JNM03|Battle Frontier Challenge: The Flute Cup!]]''. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Pinsir is Goh's first Pokémon to [[List of Pokémon that are not part of an evolutionary line|not be part of an evolutionary line]]. ==References== {{reflist}} ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Pinsir}} * [[Goh's Heracross]] {{Goh's Pokémon|bug}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Goh's Pokémon|Pinsir]] [[Category:Pokémon GO characters]] [[es:Pinsir de Goh]] [[fr:Scarabrute de Goh]] [[it:Pinsir di Goh]] [[ja:ゴウのカイロス]] [[zh:小豪的凯罗斯]]
